ticket: A reporting integration started failing after a deployment. The client receives HTTP 401 from GET /api/v1/reports. The request includes an Authorization header, but the support ticket does not include the token or token expiry details.
Users are redirected back to the login page after signing in through SSO. The browser console shows a SAML response validation error. No full assertion or personal information is available.
A scheduled service cannot reach api.example.invalid. The log says: temporary failure in name resolution. Other local tasks are running. No DNS lookup output was attached.
A dashboard loads successfully but shows yesterday's figures. The source integration reports its last successful refresh was 36 hours ago. No transformation or refresh-job logs were provided.
A user can open a business application but receives HTTP 403 when exporting a report. A colleague with a different role can export it. Role and permission configuration has not yet been compared.
